viewsWelcome.contents:
Ask **@idexal** in the chat to run a task. Live plan steps and agent progress appear here.
[Open Idexal Chat](command:idexal.openChat)
[Clear Task List](command:idexal.clearTasks)
Background processes started by agents (dev servers, watchers) appear here with live output. Start one by asking **@idexal** to run a long-running command.

Animated live progress cards appear here as agents work: the plan checklist, each tool call and outcome, review verdicts, and the final summary.
[Open Idexal Chat](command:idexal.openChat)

idexal.nodePath.markdownDescription: Path to the Node.js executable used to run the AI Core (defaults to `node` on PATH, or `$IDEXAL_NODE`).

idexal.aiCorePath.markdownDescription: Path to the Idexal AI Core `src/cli.ts` (or its containing folder). Defaults to `$IDEXAL_AI_CORE`, then a `idexal/ai-core` checkout next to this extension.

idexal.showAgentEvents.markdownDescription: Render the live agent transcript inside the chat response: plan checklist, agent start/end, tool calls and outcomes, and usage & cost. When disabled, only the streamed final answer and summary are shown.
